seoTitle: Gift Vouchers — Boat Trip Gifts in Manchester — Manchester River Cruises
seoDescription: Gift vouchers for a Manchester boat trip — give a sightseeing cruise, music night or private hire on the Ship Canal. Buy online; they get a code to book any sailing. Perfect for Christmas, birthdays, Mother’s Day and Father’s Day.
heading: Give Manchester from the water
intro: The gift of a cruise on the Manchester Ship Canal — a sightseeing tour, a party night or the whole boat. Buy online and they get a code to book the sailing that suits them.
keyFacts: Delivered by email as a code (TBC)

sections.heading: Buy a gift voucher
body: Choose an amount and pay securely — the voucher arrives by email as a code to pass on. Denominations, validity and what it covers — TBC.

sections.heading: A gift for every occasion
body: We run cruises all year round — so a voucher works for whatever’s coming up.

sections.heading: Give a day out they’ll remember
body: A Manchester River Cruises gift voucher is the easy present that turns into a proper experience on the water. Buy in minutes; they book when they’re ready.

sections.heading: Popular experiences to gift
body: Not sure what to choose? These are the ones people love to give.

cards.name: Christmas
cards.desc: The easy present that isn’t another jumper — a festive party night or a winter sightseeing cruise on the Ship Canal.

cards.name: Birthdays
cards.desc: Give a birthday on the water — a party cruise with a licensed bar, or a relaxed daytime sightseeing trip.

cards.name: Mother's Day
cards.desc: Treat her to a scenic cruise through the heart of Manchester — a proper day out rather than a bunch of flowers.

cards.name: Father's Day
cards.desc: For the dad who has everything — the story of the docks and the ship canal, told from the water with live commentary.

cards.name: Buy online
cards.desc: Choose an amount (or a specific experience) and pay securely. Denominations and options — TBC.

cards.name: They receive a code
cards.desc: The voucher arrives by email as a gift code to pass on. Delivery and personalisation details — TBC.

cards.name: They book any sailing
cards.desc: The recipient redeems the code against a sailing that suits them. What the voucher can cover — TBC.

cards.name: City River Tour
cards.desc: Our signature 60-minute sightseeing cruise through the heart of Manchester.

cards.name: Music & Party Nights
cards.desc: Tribute nights, DJ cruises and party boats with a licensed bar.

cards.name: Christmas on the water
cards.desc: Festive party nights and seasonal sailings through the winter.

cards.name: Private Hire
cards.desc: The whole boat, exclusively yours, for a celebration to remember.

items.question: How long is a gift voucher valid for?
items.answer: Validity period — TBC. (Typically vouchers are valid for a set number of months from purchase.)

items.question: How does the recipient redeem it?
items.answer: The recipient enters their gift code at checkout when booking online. Exact redemption steps — TBC.

items.question: What amounts / denominations are available?
items.answer: You’ll be able to choose from set amounts and/or a custom value. Available denominations — TBC.

items.question: Can a voucher be used against any cruise?
items.answer: The intention is that vouchers can be redeemed against any sailing, subject to availability. Exactly which cruises and events are covered — TBC.

items.question: What happens if the recipient doesn’t use it in time?
items.answer: Expiry and any extension policy — TBC.

items.question: Can I choose a specific experience rather than an amount?
items.answer: Yes — you’ll be able to gift a specific cruise or a monetary amount. Options — TBC.
